title: Meeting consent
description: Whether participants are told that a meeting is recorded and transcribed, and whether their consent is needed first. This is the deployment's default; a meeting can be started with a different choice unless that is turned off below. What LMA records is supporting evidence of what participants said, not a legal determination of consent; see the Meeting Consent documentation.
appliesText: A saved change applies to meetings whose consent starts after the save; a meeting already under way keeps the mode and rule it started with.

mode.title: Consent mode
mode.description: Off: no notice. Notify: a notice is posted and the meeting is recorded and transcribed unless a participant objects, which stops it. Opt-in: a request is posted and nothing is recorded or transcribed until the consent rule below is met; an objection stops it again.

consentRule.title: Consent rule (opt-in)
consentRule.description: Each participant: every participant present replies with consent. Owner attests: the meeting's owner confirms that everyone agreed, for example out loud or in the invitation's terms.

enumLabels.owner_attests: The meeting owner attests that everyone agreed

notifyNoticeText.title: Notice text (notify)
notifyNoticeText.description: Posted when a notify meeting starts. {LMA_USER} is the person using LMA, {meeting} the meeting's name, and {consent_phrase} and {objection_phrase} the first phrase of each list below. A Virtual Participant posts a line after it saying how to reply (Type or say "LMA, I consent" or "LMA, I object"), so the text needs no reply instruction of its own.

optInNoticeText.title: Consent request text (opt-in)
optInNoticeText.description: Posted when an opt-in meeting starts. The same placeholders as the notice text, and the same line on how to reply follows it.

videoNoticeText.title: Video sentence
videoNoticeText.description: Added to the end of the notice or consent request whenever the meeting's video is recorded: by a Virtual Participant recording video, or by the Desktop Capture App, the Stream Audio/Video page or the browser extension recording screen video. It is shown, posted or spoken with the notice, and recorded with it on the meeting's consent record. No placeholders.

consentPhrases.title: Consent phrases
consentPhrases.description: Comma-separated. A reply containing one of these, as whole words and ignoring case and punctuation, is read as consent, unless it also contains an objection phrase.

objectionPhrases.title: Objection phrases
objectionPhrases.description: Comma-separated. A reply containing one of these is read as an objection. Objections are looked for first, so "I do not consent" is an objection although it contains "consent".

allowPerMeetingOverride.title: Allow a different choice per meeting
allowPerMeetingOverride.description: On: whoever starts a meeting may choose another mode or rule for it. Off: a meeting may only use this mode and rule or a stricter one.

keepEvidenceScreenshots.title: Keep evidence screenshots
keepEvidenceScreenshots.description: On: screenshots kept as consent evidence stay with the meeting until it is deleted. Off: each screenshot is deleted as soon as it has been checked, and only the check's result is kept.

verifierModelId.title: Evidence check model
verifierModelId.description: The Amazon Bedrock vision model that checks a consent evidence screenshot: whether the notice is visible, which replies are visible and from whom, and whether anybody objected. Its answer is supporting evidence only; it never changes a meeting's consent status. Image-capable models only.

clientsWithoutConsent.title: Streaming clients without a consent step
clientsWithoutConsent.description: What the WebSocket transcriber does, when the mode is Notify or Opt-in, with a meeting from a streaming client that shows no consent step: the Stream Audio embed, and browser extension and Desktop Capture App builds from before the consent step. Accept with a warning: the meeting is recorded and transcribed as before, with no consent record, and a warning is logged. Refuse: the meeting is not recorded or transcribed, and the client is told why. Choose Refuse once every client in use has been updated.

enumLabels.accept_with_warning: Accept with a warning (no consent record)

leaveOnObjection.title: Virtual Participant leaves after an objection
leaveOnObjection.description: On: when a participant objects, in the meeting chat or aloud, the Virtual Participant stops recording and transcribing, says so, and leaves the meeting. Off: it stops and stays, so recording can resume if the participant later consents. Either way the objection is recorded.

readSpokenReplies.title: Read spoken replies
readSpokenReplies.description: On: the Virtual Participant also reads consent replies and objections said aloud and addressed to LMA ("LMA, I consent", "LMA, I object"). While consent is awaited it sends the meeting audio to the meeting's transcription engine to hear them; nothing it hears is recorded or kept except the replies. Off: it reads replies in the meeting chat only, and sends no meeting audio anywhere until consent is given.

advanceConsentEnabled.title: Allow consent given in advance
advanceConsentEnabled.description: On, the default: a signed-in person on a meeting's participant list can consent before the meeting, from the meeting's consent link, for that meeting or for the meetings its organizer holds until a date, and manage or withdraw it on the My consents page. In a meeting a Virtual Participant joins, an attendee whose display name matches one listed person with such a consent is counted as having consented; the notice is still posted, naming them, and anyone can still object. Off: no new consent can be given in advance and none is counted in a meeting; each person can still read and withdraw their own.

advanceConsentMaxDays.title: Longest consent given in advance, in days
advanceConsentMaxDays.description: The latest date a consent for an organizer's meetings may run to, counted from the day it is given: 1 to 365 days. A consent for one meeting counts for at most this long too. A change applies to consents given after the save.

advanceConsentText.title: Consent text (given in advance)
advanceConsentText.description: What a person agrees to when they consent in advance, shown on the consent page and kept with the consent exactly as shown, with its SHA-256 hash and a version. {organizer} is the meeting's owner in LMA, {meeting} the meeting's name, and {scope} what the consent covers (the meeting, or every meeting the organizer holds until a date, with the label when one is chosen). A change applies to consents given after the save; those already given keep the text they were given with.

keepAdvanceConsentDeviceDetails.title: Keep sign-in device details with consents given in advance
keepAdvanceConsentDeviceDetails.description: Off, the default: a consent given in advance holds the person's email address, account id, the time, the scope and the text they agreed to, and nothing about the device they used. On: it also holds the IP address and the browser's user agent the request came from, for consents given after the save. Decide this with whoever advises your organisation on consent records; the IP address is personal data.
